Definition: of foreign origin (H3828); the incense-tree, i.e. (by implication) incense itself:--frankincense.
BiblicalUsage: líbanos means frankincense, and once is enough to see what it is doing. In Matthew 2:11, "and frankincense"; and in Revelation 18:13, "and frankincense".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe frankincense belongs at the manger and at the altar — the wise men laid it before the child, and Babylon traded in it to the end.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
